claude-s · promo-video

A viewfinder logo that films its own product

a 12 s launch promo for i18n.doctor from its repo: the scan-bracket logo is the camera; show paste, scan, report and the one-click fix with real numbers only

What the skill did

  • First video, i18n.doctor (12.5 s, 60 fps). Everything comes from the product's repo: the favicon's four rounded brackets and dot, Fustat and Geist Mono, the oklch tokens from globals.css, the app's own copy and its 50-segment coverage bar. The only numbers are the ones on its public Recent Scans table: cal.com, 4,748 keys, 42 locales, 82 %.
  • The hook is a depth field of the app's real translation keys (en.json, plus its de, ja, zh, fr and es strings) on three planes, with only the focus plane sharp. The headline is readable on frame 0. Then every key implodes into one dot, the brackets snap round it to form the logo, and an iris opens the light world out of that dot.
  • The brackets fly out to the frame corners and become the HUD while one card does the whole product. A pasted URL gets a selection flash, the scan checklist ticks, and the card reframes from centred to two columns as it grows into the report. The stats count up. The camera pushes 1.4x onto the bar as the fix fills the last nine segments and turns them green, and the app's own "Draft PR created" toast docks in the card.
  • The brackets close back into the logo, its dot opens a second iris onto the brand colour, and the mark slides into the lock-up. The tagline passes through two of the app's own translations before English, and the cursor presses Scan Repo.
  • Built with the upgraded toolkit (ground, headline, card, pill dot/shadow, counter roll: false) after two rounds with a fresh critic comparing it against the best product promos on prompt-motion.com. The critic rounds caught a counter bug, a double exposure, a locked layout and a spinner ending; all four were fixed.
  • Second video, the earlier demo: claude-s · silk (9 s, 60 fps), which shows the cursor choreography, the fling and the velocity-matched cuts.

Sound

  • i18n.doctor: a 120 BPM syncopated groove from the iris on. A dark swell stops dead on the logo's dot, with a pass-by across each iris. A paste click, one tick per scan step and a slot roll under the counters. Dot ticks as the bar fills, a sting on Fixed and a bloop on the toast. Then half a second of silence and an echo tail with a sub that releases to the last frame.
